name: Clairo
label: Clairo Records
lede: Claire Cottrill filmed herself lip-syncing on a laptop in thirty minutes, on a day she felt at her worst. Eight years later she was on the Coachella main stage with an album cut live to tape.

eras.title: A bedroom and a Bandcamp
eras.text: Cottrill grew up in Carlisle, Massachusetts, taught herself guitar partly from YouTube tutorials and spent her teens posting EPs under two names. A cheap keyboard, a laptop camera and one bad-skin day changed the arithmetic.

years.h: Cottrill uploads EPs under two names before anyone says Clairo
years.p: Between them, Aquarius Boy, Late Show, Moth Girl, Metal Heart and Have a Nice Day made five Bandcamp EPs. Some went up as DJ Baby Benz.

q: I didn't intend for it to be a lo-fi song.
years.src: Wikipedia: Pretty Girl · The Fader: Clairo on Pretty Girl
years.h: "Pretty Girl" goes viral off a thirty-minute laptop video
years.p: Cottrill lip-syncs in her childhood bedroom, acne showing, a Dunkin' iced coffee in frame, a Gizmo doll nearby. It takes off on YouTube that August.
years.xp:
She made the song in GarageBand on a MacBook with a small keyboard, leaning on the '80s pop from her mother's music, and has said she used "the resources around me which were pretty shitty". The video was shot in Photo Booth on a day she deliberately felt at her worst. Per Wikipedia it passed 75 million views by 2021.

The song was first recorded for a cassette compilation, The Le Sigh Vol. III, then re-recorded for her debut EP. Its predecessor, "Flaming Hot Cheetos", came out in June 2017.

years.big: "I didn't want to have to rely on anyone else."
q: I didn't want to have to rely on anyone else.
years.src: Wikipedia: Pretty Girl · The Ringer: The Curious Case · The Fader: Clairo on Pretty Girl · NME: Clairo interview
years.h: A freshman at Syracuse already has a label
years.p: Fader Label signed Cottrill to a 12-song deal. Wikipedia credits her father's link to Jon Cohen, who ran the label's Rubber Tracks studio; The Ringer says she also signed with Chance the Rapper's manager.
years.xp:
By the time The Fader interviewed her in October 2017, Cottrill was 19, just starting at Syracuse University and already on the label. Capitol, Columbia and RCA were all reported to be interested, per Wikipedia's Diary 001 article.

She left Syracuse's music business program after one year to go full time. She told NME the quote above was the reason.

eras.title: A plant rumor and a Dua Lipa tour
eras.text: The debut EP came with a national tour slot, a sold-out New York room and an internet argument over whether a viral bedroom star had been engineered.

years.h: Pitchfork gives Diary 001 a 7.0
years.p: Critic Sasha Geffen wrote that she had worked hard to make it sound this easy. The EP, on Fader Label, later went Gold in the US.

years.h: Support slot with Dua Lipa, then Bowery Ballroom sells out
years.p: Cottrill toured with Dua Lipa, headlined her own Lazy Days dates, sold out New York's Bowery Ballroom in July and played Lollapalooza in August.

q: No, I just have representation, like every single other artist you listen to.
years.src: The Ringer: The Curious Case · Wikipedia: Diary 001
years.h: Reddit asks if she's an industry plant
years.p: Threads noted that her father, Geoff Cottrill, had been a marketing executive at Converse, and asked why she hadn't said so. She answered in the New York Times.
years.xp:
The Ringer laid out the case in July 2018: Geoff Cottrill was chief marketing officer at Converse and was tied to its Rubber Tracks studio program. The piece argued that crediting advertising executives with engineering virality gives them too much credit.

Cottrill called the suspicion a sexist assumption about how women succeed, per Wikipedia's Diary 001 article.

eras.title: Polish arrives with Rostam
eras.text: The first album traded lo-fi for polished soft rock, with Rostam Batmanglij in the room. Then the pandemic sent her home to Atlanta, and into a band.

years.cap: Clairo on the Pitchfork Stage at a festival, May 30, 2019
years.h: "Bags" breaks out, and BBC Radio 1 ranks it No. 5
years.p: Clairo told NME the song came from her first romantic experiences with a girl. Radio 1 put it fifth on its 2019 Hottest Records list.
years.xp:
Per Wikipedia, Pitchfork placed "Bags" No. 3 on its year-end songs list, The Guardian No. 9 and Billboard No. 48. It was nominated for Song of the Year at the Boston Music Awards.

At the 2020 NME Awards it was nominated for Best Song in the World, and she won Best New Act in the World.

years.cap: Clairo at the El Rey, Los Angeles, April 11, 2019
years.h: Rostam in the booth, Danielle Haim on drums
years.p: Rostam Batmanglij of Vampire Weekend co-produced and co-wrote Immunity, and Clairo produced six tracks herself. Pitchfork gave it 8.0.
years.xp:
"Sofia" became her first song on the Billboard Hot 100. The album peaked at No. 51 on the Billboard 200 and went Gold in the US, per Wikipedia.

The nearly seven-minute closer, "I Wouldn't Ask You", was inspired by her juvenile rheumatoid arthritis, she told NME. The album was made in Los Angeles and Atlanta.

years.h: Lockdown in Atlanta turns into Shelly, with Claud and two Syracuse friends
years.p: Cottrill formed the band with [[Claud|34f3e890-c917-4ee1-b859-b22c48e2a42c]], Josh Mehling and Noa Frances Getzug and put out "Steeeam" and "Natural".
years.xp: Then Shelly went quiet. The next release, a double single of "Cross Your Mind" and "Hartwell", came in July 2025, per Wikipedia.

eras.title: Sling, the quiet one
eras.text: Clairo swapped synths for piano, strings and folk-rock with Jack Antonoff at Allaire and Electric Lady, then took it on the road with mixed luck.

years.h: Lorde sings backup on "Blouse" from New Zealand, in the rain
years.p: Antonoff co-produced the first Sling single. You can hear raindrops on Lorde's vocals.
years.xp: Clairo has said the song is about being sexualized in the music industry. She later played it on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, per Wikipedia.

years.h: Sling opens at No. 17
years.p: Recorded in 2020 at Allaire Studios and Electric Lady and released on Republic and Fader Label, it scored 84 on Metacritic and gave her a first top 20.

years.cap: Clairo at the Greek Theatre, Los Angeles, April 2, 2022, on the Sling tour
years.h: A bad ear in Toronto and a cancelled night in Bristol
years.p: Per Wikipedia, an in-ear monitor incident in Toronto caused temporary hearing damage, and a sinusitis-related panic attack cancelled the Bristol date before she finished the UK run in London.
years.xp: At Glastonbury that summer she wore a "Bans Off Our Bodies" T-shirt on stage, protesting restrictions on abortion. In May 2022 she had also signed a full-page New York Times ad with 160 artists responding to the overturning of Roe v. Wade.

eras.title: Soul, cut live to tape
eras.text: She left the synths and studio polish behind and cut an album live to analog tape with Leon Michels. It brought her first top 10 and first Grammy nomination.

years.src: BrooklynVegan: Clairo announces · The Line of Best Fit: Clairo Charm · Wikipedia: Charm
years.h: "Sexy to Someone" brings in Leon Michels
years.p: The lead single came with news that Michels, who leads El Michels Affair and has worked with the Dap-Kings, co-produced a fully analog record. It was cut live to tape at Diamond Mine Recording in Queens and Allaire in Woodstock.
years.xp:
BrooklynVegan reported horns, woodwinds and vintage synths on the record. The Line of Best Fit, which gave Charm 8/10, heard Blossom Dearie and Carole King's piano in it.

Allaire is the same woodland studio where she made Sling. The video for "Sexy to Someone", with a yeti, came in December 2024, per Wikipedia and Rolling Stone.

years.h: Pitchfork ranks Charm 21st of 2024
years.p: Metacritic scored it 82 and Pitchfork 7.5, per Wikipedia's reception box. It became her first US top 10, at No. 8.
years.xp:
The Guardian and NME each gave it five stars, per Wikipedia.

Singles: "Nomad" (June 28), "Juna" (July 12), "Add Up My Love" (November 1, 2024) and "Terrapin" (February 6, 2025). Pitchfork placed the album 21st on its 50 best albums of 2024.

years.h: Five days after release, "Juna" plays Fallon
years.p: Clairo performed it on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon on July 17.
years.xp: The Guardian called the performance intimate and light-hearted, and Clash called it a gossamer spider's web of soulful pop, per Wikipedia.

years.src: Stereogum: Clairo Juna video · Wikipedia: Juna
years.h: A VFW-hall wrestling show in Worcester
years.p: The "Juna" video, her first professional music video in over six years, watches a battle royal, then joins the crowd and poses backstage with the wrestlers.
years.xp:
Bradley J. Calder shot it at Beyond Wrestling's Wrestling Open in Worcester, Massachusetts, per Stereogum. Stereogum noted that none of her first three albums had produced an official video for an album track.

The song reached No. 1 on Billboard's TikTok chart and went Gold in the US, Australia and New Zealand, per Wikipedia.

years.cap: Clairo at the Fonda Theatre, Los Angeles, September 8, 2024, on the Charm tour
years.h: A first Grammy nomination, then Webster Hall and the Fonda
years.p: Charm was nominated for Best Alternative Music Album at the 67th Grammys. The fall tour with Alice Phoebe Lou ran September to November, with residencies at New York's Webster Hall and Los Angeles' Fonda.

eras.title: Bernie Sanders, then Atlantic
eras.text: Charm kept working after its year. Clairo became a festival main-stage act who talks politics from the stage.

years.cap: Clairo supporting Sabrina Carpenter at BST Hyde Park, London, July 6, 2025
years.h: Bernie Sanders introduces her Coachella set
years.p: Sanders and Rep. Maxwell Frost introduced her, per Wikipedia, citing her advocacy on women's rights and Gaza.
years.xp: Clairo has also signed open letters on LGBT+ conversion therapy (July 2020) and Gaza (October 2023), and played Artists for Aid benefit concerts in London in January and July 2024, per Wikipedia.

years.h: Ayo Edebiri directs "Terrapin", with "Weird Al" Yankovic
years.p: The video for the Charm single arrived on February 6, 2025.

years.h: Clairo signs with Atlantic Records
years.p: Wikipedia lists the move as September 2025. Charm itself came out on her own Clairo Records imprint.
